_note: v4 'Ask HubSpot. Then ask us.' The section is aimed at HubSpot: each item pairs the question to ask HubSpot with how Salesforce proves it live. Tone is confident and factual, never snarky; gaps are framed as questions. Do NOT publish the internal 'what it exposes' notes (seller guide only).
title: Ask HubSpot: can you prove it? Live, with our data.
subtitle: Then ask us. Salesforce will show you, live, on your data.
framing: Ask for a proof of concept on the first two. They're the hardest to fake in a demo.

videoAsks.askHubSpot: Can you build our real objects, live?
videoAsks.full: Build our real objects in the demo (projects, work orders, job orders, matters, SOWs) and how they connect.
videoAsks.salesforce: Custom objects and account hierarchies, built live on your data.

videoAsks.askHubSpot: Can you run quote to service in one system?
videoAsks.full: Show the full path from quote to approval, contract, delivery handoff, execution, billing and service, and which parts need a separate product or integration.
videoAsks.salesforce: Revenue Cloud → Field Service → Service Cloud, on one platform.

videoAsks.askHubSpot: Can your AI use all our data, with guardrails?
videoAsks.full: Show how your AI uses data from outside the CRM (project, billing, scheduling, support) and what governs its actions and access.
videoAsks.salesforce: Agentforce on Data 360: tested, versioned, protected by the Einstein Trust Layer.

topics.askHubSpot: Can you build our real objects (projects or pursuits, job orders and candidates, matters, SOWs, work orders) with the relationships between them, live, with our data?
topics.salesforce: Yes. Custom objects with relationships, multi-level account hierarchies and record types per line of business.

topics.askHubSpot: Can you give us a 3-year price that includes every capability we listed, the tier each requires, and how marketing contacts, seats and add-ons change the price as we grow?
topics.salesforce: Yes. One platform you start small on and grow into. See the cost scenario in check 2 above.

topics.askHubSpot: Can you show the full path from quote to approval, contract, delivery handoff, execution, billing and service? Which parts need a separate product or integration?
topics.salesforce: Yes. Revenue Cloud, Field Service, Service Cloud and Agentforce Voice on one platform.

topics.askHubSpot: Can you show complex approval flows, role- and record-level security across business units, sandboxes and change management as we grow?
topics.salesforce: Yes. Record-level security, role hierarchies, approval flows and sandboxes to test every change.

topics.askHubSpot: Can your AI use our data from outside the CRM, and can you show tracing, testing and rollback when an agent gets something wrong?
topics.salesforce: Yes. Data 360 with Zero Copy, Testing Center, agent versions with rollback, and the Einstein Trust Layer.

moreQuestions.askHubSpot: Can you show a live two-way sync with our ERP, billing and dispatch systems? Is it native or custom, and who builds, monitors and fixes it?
How do we give sales, service, dispatch, finance and executives different access, and which tier does that require?
What happens when AI credits run out mid-month? Which agents are still in beta, and which beta features will start consuming credits?
Is your voice agent generally available? How do calls, transcripts and AI summaries land on the customer record?
If your pricing model is changing, what does our pricing look like in year two and at renewal?
